title: House leaders welcome signing of bill postponing BSKE to 2028

blocks.text: House Deputy Speaker Franciso Paolo Ortega V and House Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability Chairperson Joel Chua welcomed on Friday the enactment of a measure postponing the November 2026 barangay and sangguniang kabataan elections to November 2028.
